title: Kyte
tagline: Kyte provides you a web3 platform which serves as a dynamic decentralized social space where you can engage in collaborative interactions, engage in messaging conversations and partake in 1-on-1 audio calls.
description: Kyte is a web3 social networking platform dedicated to safeguarding user privacy through the implementation of decentralized technologies while ensuring a seamless and enjoyable user experience. You can make your own username for Kyte and connect your Lens profile which is all stored in Polybase to provide a seamless login experience. You can choose to display any of your usernames like Kyte, Lens or ENS on your profile. You can interact with your friends with all kinds of on-chain social actions using Lens Protocol social graph where all the assets are stored on IPFS and all videos are streamed using Livepeer. Also you can send direct wallet to wallet messages as well as messages to lens profiles and enjoy chatting with them. Moreover you can even engage in 1-on-1 audio calls with them using Huddle01 Divergent Network.
how_its_made:
The project is built with the help of technologies like Polybase, Huddle01, Livepeer, IPFS, ENS, Lens Protocol, XMTP

We used the following sponsor technologies :
- Polybase for storing user information like username, lens profile, ENS full decentralized
- Huddle01 for audio calls using divergent network
- IPFS for storing assets
- Livepeer for video streaming
- ENS to showcase user's .eth name on their profile
